body_markdown:
[chriswestergaard](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/chriswestergaard)


October 4, 2026, 11:14pm 1


My main use of Newsblur is as an aggregator to distribute my feeds to my RSS reader of choice ReadKit. My ‘regular’ RSS feeds are showing up, but all my newsletter feeds seem to be stuck in Newsblur. I went and found 115 unread newsletters (I do subscribe to a number of daily senders) stuck there, some from mid September.


This is new behavior. Even if the Newsblur email address is slow in adding these to Newsblur, as unread items, shouldn’t they eventually appear in ReadKit? None of these are Substack, they are all independent sites using different newsletter services.


[chriswestergaard](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/chriswestergaard)


October 5, 2026, 1:28am 2


After making this post, and viewing a few of my most recent newsletters on Newsblur on the web, I launched ReadKit and what should appear but my 100+ unread email newsletters from the past few weeks.
